content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Payment Methods ## slug: payment-methods ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## Introduction The purpose of the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object is to store the method by which you charge your customers. {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} types are segmented by {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}} and can be related to {{variable.Object_Account}}s, {{variable.Object_Contact}}s, and/or other objects. Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}} is built with PCI compliance in mind, we never store sensitive {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} details. Click [here](/v1/docs/pci-compliance) for information on PCI compliance. ## Obtain Payment Methods *To capture card or bank account information from a customer, there are multiple, PCI compliant, options using Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}}.* ### Phone *If you are not recording your phone calls (if you are, this goes against the tenants of PCI compliance)...* * **{{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} Object** Manually enter the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} through the Card or ACH {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}}. A real-time API call sends the record to {{variable.Product_Stripe}}/{{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} to tokenize the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} information. A card can be verified within seconds, where for {{variable.Product_Stripe}} ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s, it takes 4-5 days to be verified. * **{{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}}** Manually enter the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} through a popup, embedded Visualforce Page, or LWC component. The {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} supports credit card, debit card, and ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} types. ### Web * [PayLink](/v1/docs/introduction-1) feature. * Public Web Page as part of your website utilizing our [REST API](https://github.com/blackthornio/documentation#rest-payments-api){target="_blank"}. * Salesforce {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} Within a Salesforce {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}}, you can display the native objects to enter {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} information with the default {{glossary.user interface (UI)}}, or you can create a custom {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} user interface to use with our [Apex API](https://github.com/blackthornio/documentation#apex-payments-api){target="_blank"}. ### In-Person * Create your own custom page as part of a web app. Use our [REST or Apex API ](/v1/docs/developer-apis) on your mobile device. * Use the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} in Salesforce. ## Initial Setup ### Setup Wizard When you click **Grant Access** in the {{variable.Product_Payments}} {{variable.Feature_PaymentsSetupWizard}}, a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} with {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}} = "Card" is created. If you select "Yes" for ACH payments, a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} with {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}} = "ACH" is also created. These record types live on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object and relate to two different {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} page layouts and used to collect necessary card or bank account information. :::(Info) () If you need to add ACH payments, navigate back to the Blackthorn | Payments Setup Wizard tab, click on the "Record Types" step, select "Yes" for ACH payments, then click **Make magic happen**. ::: ### Card Payment Method ![H_01_09_Card Payment Method](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_09_Card%20Payment%20Method.png){height="" width=""} * * * ![Create a Charge Card Payment Method](https://youtu.be/tfWezb1bWpQ){height="480" width="640"} 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object. ***Lightning:** Click on the App Launcher > Under "All Items" > Click on Payment Methods.* ***Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click on Payment Methods.* 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Select "Card" for the {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}}. 4. Required card details to enter * {{variable.Field_PM_HoldersName}} (required) * {{variable.Field_PM_Number}} * {{variable.Field_PM_ExpirationMonth}} (required) * {{variable.Field_PM_ExpirationYear}} (required) * {{variable.Field_PM_CVV}} * {{variable.Field_PM_PostalCode}} (required) * {{variable.Field_PM_Email}} * While this is not a required field, we recommend you require it as we use email for {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} matching logic in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. * *For example, if you already have an existing {{variable.Product_Stripe}}/{{variable.Product_Authorizenet}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} with a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} and a new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} with the same email is added, it directly relates to the existing {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record.* * {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentGateway}} * If a {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentGateway}} is not selected, the default gateway will be used. * Related To Fields * If you add additional objects to the "Relationships" step in the Setup Wizard, meaning you want additional objects as the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} parent, those related objects will show up in this section as a "Lookup Field" along with the {{variable.Field_PM_Account}} and {{variable.Field_PM_Contact}} lookup fields. We recommend entering an {{variable.Field_PM_Account}} and {{variable.Field_PM_Contact}} for all {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} records. * {{variable.Field_PM_Street}} - This field can be used for additional verification for the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. * The Payment Gateway Data section is data created for error logging and storing the tokenized card details on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. * {{variable.Field_PM_Fingerprint}} is not available with Authorize.net gateway. * When using External Accounts as part of Stripe Connect, the {{variable.Field_PM_CustomerID}} will not be populated on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. * When a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} with {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} = "Valid" is created, the {{variable.Field_PM_CardID}}, {{variable.Field_PM_CustomerID}}, and {{variable.Field_PM_Fingerprint}} fields are populated. 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. What happens after clicking Save? The card information is sent to Stripe/Authorize.net. The sensitive card information is removed from the Salesforce record and the gateway sends back a token for the Payment Method. This keeps us PCI compliant. No card information is ever saved in Salesforce. :::(Info) (How do I change the Postal Code to not required?) The default setting for the {{variable.Field_PM_PostalCode}} field is required. If you need to change the default setting to not required, contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}}, and they will change the setting. ::: #### Card Status When saving the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} record, the {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} will update to either "Valid" or "Invalid." * When {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} = "Valid", the record can be used to process immediate or scheduled {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. * When {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} = "Invalid", the record cannot be used. There are two error fields on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} record's page layout, {{variable.Field_PM_ErrorMessage}} and {{variable.Field_PM_ErrorType}}, that provide information on why the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}'s {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} is "Invalid". :::(Info) (Blocking AMEX Transactions) Need a way to block American Express Card charges? Read more [here](/v1/docs/payment-gateway). ::: ### ACH Payment Method #### For Stripe ![H_01_09_ACH Payment Method Stripe](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_09_ACH%20Payment%20Method%20Stripe.png){height="" width=""} **Micro-Deposit Verification** Before attempting to create an ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}, it may be helpful to confirm that a {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} {{variable.Object_Contact}} record exists for the bank account holder. This will help ensure that {{variable.Object_Transaction}} data will be recorded for the intended person. Many organizations request a voided check to ensure the accuracy of the data to be entered. **Stripe Fingerprint** The [Fingerprint](https://stripe.com/docs/api/customer_bank_accounts/object#customer_bank_account_object-fingerprint){target="_blank"} is automatically added to an ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} once it has been saved and validated. This ID is used to uniquely identify bank accounts. Users can opt out of using the fingerprint matching logic by using one of our Custom Settings: 1. Navigate to Custom Settings in Setup. 2. Click **Blackthorn Pay - Trigger Settings**. 3. Click **Manage**. 4. Click **Edit**. 5. Find "Disable Fingerprint Matching (ACH)" and mark it as "TRUE". Following the above steps will bypass the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} fingerprint matching logic and defer to Blackthorn's legacy ACH matching logic which uses an ACH key and Customer ID. #### Add ACH Payment Methods with Non-USD Currencies To add ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s with non-USD {{variable.Field_PM_CurrencyISO}} values to {{variable.Product_Stripe}} accounts, you need to update the ACH {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}} on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object. 1. Go to Setup. 2. Click the Object Manager tab. 3. Go to the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object. ![Update PM Currency_PM Object](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Update%20PM%20Currency_PM%20Object.png){height="" width=""} 5. Click the Record Types tab in the left navigation bar. ![Update PM Currency_Record Type](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Update%20PM%20Currency_Record%20Type.png){height="" width=""} 7. Click ACH. ![Update PM Currency_Click ACH](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Update%20PM%20Currency_Click%20ACH.png){height="" width=""} 9. Click {{variable.Button_SF_Edit}} next to {{variable.Field_PM_CurrencyISO}}. ![Update PM Currency_Edit](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Update%20PM%20Currency_Edit.png){height="" width=""} 11. In the Picklist Values’ Available Values Column, select the currency ISO code you want to use. 13. Click **Add**. ![Update PM Currency_Add ACH](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Update%20PM%20Currency_Add%20ACH.png){height="" width=""} 15. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. #### Create an ACH Payment Method ![Create an ACH Payment Method](https://youtu.be/qFRwuQIuCCo){height="480" width="640"} 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object. ***Lightning:** Click on the App Launcher > Under "All Items" > Click on Payment Methods.* ***Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click on Payment Methods.* 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Set {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}}= "ACH". 4. Required ACH details to enter: * {{variable.Field_PM_HoldersName}} * {{variable.Field_PM_AccountNumber}} * {{variable.Field_PM_RoutingNumber}} * {{variable.Field_PM_AccountHolderType}} *The fields on the right-hand side of the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} detail section will be automatically populated from {{variable.Product_Stripe}}.* 5. Bank account verification fields: {{variable.Field_PM_MicroDepositOne}} and {{variable.Field_PM_MicroDepositTwo}} *Your customer will receive two verification amounts in their bank account. They will need to provide you with those two amounts to make their {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} "Verified". Only enter the amounts (such as 35 and 42, there is no need for 0.xx or a decimal).* - {{variable.Field_PM_Email}} (Optional) The {{variable.Field_PM_Email}} field is not a required field; however, we highly recommend requiring it as we use email for {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} matching logic in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}.*For example, if you already have an existing {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} with a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} and a new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} with the same email is added, it directly relates to the existing {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record.* - **Related To Fields** If you add additional objects to the "Relationships" step in the Setup Wizard, meaning you want additional objects as the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} parent, those related objects would show up in this section as a "Lookup Field" along with the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Account}} and {{variable.Field_Transaction_Contact}} lookup fields.*We recommend entering a contact and/or account for all {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} records.* - **Optional Fields** - {{variable.Field_PM_Street}} can be used for additional verification for the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} and is only required if you enable it in your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} Dashboard. - The Payment Gateway Data section is data created by {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. When a "Valid" {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is created the {{variable.Field_PM_CardID}}, {{variable.Field_PM_CustomerID}}, and {{variable.Field_PM_Fingerprint}} fields are populated.*When using External Accounts as part of Stripe Connect, {{variable.Field_PM_CustomerID}} will not be populated on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}.* 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. :::(Info) (What happens when you click save?) The bank information is sent to Stripe. The sensitive bank account information is removed from the Salesforce record and Stripe sends back a [token](https://stripe.com/docs/payments#collecting-payment-information){target="_blank"} for the Payment Method. This keeps us PCI compliant. No bank account information is ever saved in Salesforce. ::: **ACH Status** The {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} will update to "Pending" when the bank information has been entered and the record has been saved. If there is anything wrong with the {{variable.Field_PM_AccountNumber}} or {{variable.Field_PM_RoutingNumber}} you will receive an error message. When you enter the micro-deposit numbers (this may take a few days to capture) and save the record, the {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} updates to "Verified". At this point, you are able to capture {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. Keep in mind that {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s generally take 4-5 days to show up as a "Pending" amount in your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account or External Account if Stripe Connect is enabled. If the micro-deposit numbers are incorrect, the {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} will update to "Verification Failed". Once the correct micro-deposits are entered, the {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} will update to "Verified". If a Transfer sent to this bank account fails, the {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} updates to "Errored" and will not continue to send Transfers until the bank details are updated. There are two error fields on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} record's page layout, {{variable.Field_PM_ErrorType}} and {{variable.Field_PM_ErrorMessage}}, that provide information about why the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is "Invalid". #### For Authorize.net 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object. ***Lightning:** Click on the App Launcher > Under "All Items" > Click on Payment Methods.* ***Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click on Payment Methods.* 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Set {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}}= "ACH". 4. Required ACH details to enter: * {{variable.Field_PM_HoldersName}} * {{variable.Field_PM_AccountNumber}} * {{variable.Field_PM_RoutingNumber}} * {{variable.Field_PM_AccountHolderType}} 5. Set the {{variable.Field_PM_ECheckType}} (CCD, PPD, WEB). [Visit Authorize.net](https://developer.authorize.net/api/reference/features/echeck.html#Understanding_eCheck_Types) to know the more about echecks. 6. Set the {{variable.Field_PM_BankAccountType}} (Optional). 7. Set the {{variable.Field_PM_BankName}} (Optional). For ACH test {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s, a valid [Routing Number](/v1/docs/test-data) is required. :::(Info) () You can set the Customer Lookup field if you don't want to create a new customer. ::: 8. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. :::(Info) (**What happens when you click save?**) The bank information is sent to Authorize.net. The sensitive bank account information is removed from the Salesforce record and Authorize.net sends back a token for the Payment Method. This keeps us PCI compliant. No bank account information is ever saved in Salesforce. ::: * **Email (Optional)** {{variable.Field_PM_Email}} is not a required field, however, we highly recommend requiring it as we use email for {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} matching logic in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. *For example, if you already have an existing {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} with a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} and a new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} with the same email is added, it directly relates to the existing {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record.* * **Related To Fields** If you add additional objects to the "Relationships" step in the {{variable.Feature_PaymentsSetupWizard}}, meaning you want additional objects as the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} parent, those related objects would show up in this section as a "Lookup Field" along with the {{variable.Field_PM_Account}} and {{variable.Field_PM_Contact}} lookup fields. *We recommend entering a {{variable.Field_PM_Account}} and/or {{variable.Field_PM_Contact}} for all {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} records.* * **Optional Fields** * {{variable.Field_PM_Street}} can be used for additional verification for the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. * The Payment Gateway Data section is data created for error logging and storing the tokenized ID's in Salesforce. When a "Valid" {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is created the {{variable.Field_PM_CardID}}, {{variable.Field_PM_CustomerID}}. **ACH Status** The {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} will update to "Valid" when the bank information has been entered and the record has been saved. If there is anything wrong with the {{variable.Field_PM_AccountNumber}} or {{variable.Field_PM_RoutingNumber}} you will receive an error message. There are two error fields on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} record's page layout, {{variable.Field_PM_ErrorType}} and {{variable.Field_PM_ErrorMessage}}, that provide information about why the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is "Invalid". *Please note that ACH transactions with {{variable.Field_PM_ECheckType}} = "WEB" can't be refunded. You will see a validation error message if a WEB {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is attempted to Refund.* *Kindly [visit Authorize.net](https://developer.authorize.net/api/reference/features/echeck.html#eCheck_Type_Requirements) to know the more about eCheck Type Requirements* :::(Info) (**Card and ACH notes**) When entering the {{variable.Field_PM_CVV}} and information in the billing fields, there is an [AVS](https://stripe.com/docs/disputes/prevention#avs-check) (address verification) check and the three fields: {{variable.Field_PM_CVVCheck}}, {{variable.Field_PM_StreetCheck}}, and {{variable.Field_PM_PostalCodeCheck}} will automatically update with an "Unavailable", "Pass" or "Fail" status. If you have more than one Payment Gateway set up, manually enter in the {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentGateway}} lookup field to make your selection otherwise, if left "Blank", the [default](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payment-gateway) Payment Gateway will be used. ::: ### Non-Gateway Payment Methods You can create records which represent a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}, but they are not actually sent to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}. This means that any {{variable.Object_Transaction}} linked to these records are symbolic, i.e. not sent to the gateway. In order to create a Non-Gateway {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}: 1. Create a new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} record. 2. Uncheck the {{variable.Field_PM_SendtoGateway}} checkbox. 3. Populate all the required fields. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ## Remove the Payment Method Once a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} record in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} has synced to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} ({{variable.Product_Stripe}}/{{variable.Product_Authorizenet}}), you are unable to delete the record. If you need to remove the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} for any reason, that can be done by clicking the {{variable.Button_PGC_RemoveFromGateway}} button or checking the {{variable.Field_PGC_RemovefromGateway}} checkbox. This functionality was created so historical information can be kept while ceasing all ways to capture transactions. 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object. * Lightning: Click on the app launcher > Under "All Items" > Click on Payment Methods. * Classic: Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click on Payment Methods. 2. Click on the record you want to remove from {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. 4. Click the {{variable.Button_PGC_RemoveFromGateway}} button or check the {{variable.Field_PGC_RemovefromGateway}} checkbox. The {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} will update to "Deleted from Payment Gateway". ![H_01_09_Remove Payment Method](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_09_Remove%20Payment%20Method.png){height="" width=""} ## Related Contact, Account, and Lead Logic 1. When defining the {{variable.Field_PM_Contact}} and/or {{variable.Field_PM_Account}} fields on a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} for a new customer, the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record will inherit the same {{variable.Object_Contact}} and {{variable.Object_Account}} as well. 2. If you set the {{variable.Field_PM_Contact}} field on a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} where the {{variable.Object_Contact}} is related to an {{variable.Object_Account}}, the {{variable.Object_Account}} will automatically be added to the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} {{variable.Field_PM_Account}} field. 3. When the {{variable.Field_PGC_Contact}}, {{variable.Field_PGC_Account}}, or {{variable.Field_PGC_Lead}} fields are set on the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record, the newly created {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} will inherit the same {{variable.Object_Contact}}, {{variable.Object_Account}}, and {{variable.Object_Lead}} as well. ## Remove the Payment Method Parent Object 1. Navigate to Setup. 2. In the Quick Find, type in and search for "Custom Settings". 3. Click **Manage** next to Payment Method Parents. 4. Click **Delete** next to the object you want to remove. 5. Delete the lookup fields on both the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object and your object. ## Update an Existing Payment Method :::(Info) (**Need to update an existing Payment Method?**) Sometimes Payment Methods expire, but retain the same card details like card number. When this happens you can edit the expiration date. See instructions below: ::: 1. Search for the existing {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} that requires the update. 2. Click **Edit**. 3. Type in the new 2 digit month value in the {{variable.Field_PM_ExpirationMonth}} field. 4. Type in the new 4 digit year value in the {{variable.Field_PM_ExpirationYear}} field. 5. Click **Save**. The updated {{variable.Field_PM_ExpirationMonth}} and {{variable.Field_PM_ExpirationYear}} fields will be sent to {{variable.Product_Stripe}} for the edited {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. ## Troubleshooting If you have received an error with your {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} or have a question, please view our [Troubleshooting](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-troubleshooting){target=`_blank`} or [FAQ](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-faq){target=`_blank`} page.
